description.text: A special Scarlet & Violet set released on 2 August 2024 with more than 95 cards, set in Kitakami. It brought the first card of the Mythical Pecharunt, as Pecharunt ex, and the first Pokémon ex of the Loyal Three it commands, Okidogi, Munkidori and Fezandipiti, from The Teal Mask. Like other special sets it had no booster boxes, and it came in Elite Trainer Boxes, booster bundles, tins and collections, some with promos drawn in the style of ukiyo-e prints.
